description: Every call behind one of your polls' results, oldest first: the prompt and system prompt exactly as sent, every setting, the raw reply, how it was read, which model answered, tokens and charges, and read_market (whether its search read a prediction market). Filter by run. as_of reads each answer as it was read then. Only the poll's owner reads its calls, public or not: a public poll's readers get its results (get_results), which quote a sample reply per question. (GET /api/v1/polls/{id}/calls)

as_of.description: Read as things stood at this moment (RFC 3339): only runs this reader could have seen by then, each answer as it was read then.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, unchanged.

id.description: The poll's id, or its public address (slug).

name: list_calls
title: List a poll's answers
